title: claims_tidy_reply
description: The tidy-up of one task's store of verified claims. Every input row appears exactly once: as a kept row's row_id, or in a kept row's merged_from.

row_id.description: The id of the input row that is kept.

merged_from.description: Ids of input rows recording the same fact, merged into this one; empty when none.

shared_words.description: The value (a number, name, or yes/no phrase) that appears in this row's quote and in every merged row's quote, copied exactly; empty when merged_from is empty.

claim.description: The fact this row's quote shows, in one plain sentence.

note.description: For a finding row: what the reply said. Empty for a right row.

quote_contradicts_reply.description: For a finding row: yes when the quote shows the reply's fact was false; no when the grader faulted the source or the way the reply answered. Empty for other rows.

verdict.description: The row's verdict. Keep the input verdict; the only allowed change is to disputed, with a reason.

reason.description: Why you merged rows, stated only part of a claim, or changed the verdict, in one plain sentence; empty otherwise.

covers_only.description: One sentence naming the item (with model or part number), the property, the source page, and the date read, exactly as the quote supports and no wider.

does_not_cover.description: Two or three nearby things a grader might wrongly stretch this fact to (other retailers, other configurations, other dates, whether the source's other claims are true).

conflicts.description: Kept rows whose quotes give different values for the same property of the same item at the same time.

values.description: Each row's differing value, copied from that row's own quote, in the order of row_ids.

why.description: What the rows disagree about, and how the answer changes a grade, in one plain sentence.
